evidence.note: Authentication record sets Aad with AuthorizationUri, Resource and Scope. Not an OAuth kind, so no oauth sub-questions apply.
AAD resource GUID used by the Aad authentication record.
Data is fetched through AzureDataExplorer.Contents (the Kusto/ADX connector), which is not one of the listed transports.
Loads the ADX function from the shared Kusto connector.
Default cluster URL. The cluster parameter of MicrosoftSentinel.Contents is the connection target, covered by url-or-server.

Entry parameters cluster, database, query and options are passed through to AzureDataExplorerContents. database is covered by database-or-resource-id, and query is covered by other because it is query text passed as its own parameter.
start and end options set the time range, covered by date-range.
options record type (_Kusto.OptionsRecord) declares the settings the user can supply.

options-fields.text: The declared _Kusto.OptionsRecord fields are MaxRows, MaxSize, NoTruncate, AdditionalSetStatements, start and end. start and end are read by the connector: they accept a relative offset ending in 'h' or 'd' (for example '24h' or '7d') or a DateTime text value, and end defaults to the current UTC time. Any other options field is merged into the options record and passed through to AzureDataExplorer.Contents.

evidence.note: Declares the optional options fields MaxRows, MaxSize, NoTruncate, AdditionalSetStatements, start and end.
start and end are read from options and converted with StringToDateTime; the options record is merged with AdditionalRequestFields before the call.
Parses relative offsets ending in h or d, or DateTime text.
No paging code in this file; any paging is inside the ADX connector.
Results are returned by AzureDataExplorer.Contents from the Kusto service. This file does not parse any format itself, and none of the listed format ids fits, so other is used.
Column names and types come from the ADX transport and are not redefined here.
Types declared here apply only to parameters, not to returned data columns.
Transport is other, not web-contents or odata-feed, so this question's applies_when excludes the connector.
Function-level Documentation.Description, DisplayName, Caption, Name, LongDescription and Examples.
Each parameter type has Documentation.FieldCaption.
Documentation.SampleValues on parameter types, for example the cluster sample.
database and query are optional and passed through, so when they are omitted the navigator is listed at runtime from the ADX cluster.
Shared entry function that exposes that behaviour.
TestConnection names MicrosoftSentinel.Contents with the resource path, so the test runs the shared entry function.
Queries are passed to AzureDataExplorer.Contents, which folds on its own. No Table.View handlers or native query support are written in this file.
SupportsDirectQuery = true.
The connector is a single .pq file with no pqm modules.
Strings come from Extension.LoadString, so the connector uses localized strings.
Icon16 and Icon32 are defined from PNG files.
Beta = true.
No Diagnostics.Trace call exists in the file.
No export or job polling exists in the file.
No Action functions or table mutations exist in the file.
